posts.text: Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era of prosperity.' Cool. Meanwhile my rent went up again. Show me the numbers, not the ribbons. #Veloria2025

Day 1 of 12 to the vote. Two things from today: VBC covered the Kessa-North highway opening, and Kito TV's debate pressed both candidates on costings. Worth reading the full debate transcript before deciding. Election observers will publish procedure reminders this week.

Read the Kito TV debate transcript twice. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but she dodged the question on what happens to them after 2026. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing too, and nobody pressed him hard enough on it. Both owe us the arithmetic.
Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway while my fertiliser bill doubled. Nice road. Still can't afford the diesel to drive on it. #Veloria #Election
Watched the debate tonight. Arden says 200k jobs but nobody asked him how he pays for it. Ostrand's inflation numbers didn't land for me either. Ask the hard questions of both before you vote.

Saw the Kessa-North highway opening on VBC today. Good roads mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck in mud. Also watched the debate on Kito TV. Costings matter, whoever wins. Measure twice, cut once, as my late father said.

Ostrand cut a ribbon on a highway, Arden promised 200k jobs, and the debate moderators asked both how they'd pay for it. Guess which one actually got grilled on the numbers. Still undecided, still tired.

Stuck in Kessa traffic all morning and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Ostrand's road better be worth the detour. Watching the debate tonight, Mara actually had numbers for once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 2, 11 days to the vote. VeriCheck found Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and that the '40% fuel' claim uses a peak month. Economists still put a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Read the checks before you share the numbers. #Veloria2025

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, fine. But the same check says it leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. Nobody's asked him where that money comes from. Ostrand owes us answers on her numbers too. #VeloriaVotes

Fact-checkers say Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. Fair. But the same check estimates a gap of about 2% of GDP in his costings. That's the number both camps should be arguing about. Show the full arithmetic, Mara and Tomas.
Before anyone shares a screenshot: check the original source and the full Civic Front plan. Claims like 'DOUBLE VAT' need the actual text. Measure twice, cut once.
posts.orig_text: Read the Kito TV debate transcript twice. Ostrand's inflation numbers are real, but she dodged the question on what happens to them after 2026. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing too, and nobody pressed him hard enough on it. Both owe us the arithmetic.

posts.text: Kessa traffic this morning was brutal, and the new highway isn't even open yet lol. Mara better have a good answer for the detour. Debate was watchable though, she actually had numbers. #VeloriaVotes
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand and nobody on that ribbon-cutting stage has to fill a tractor. Five more years of this? No thanks. Show us the diesel receipts, Mara. #Veloria #Election

Both candidates got asked about the numbers tonight except one got it way more than the other. Ostrand's inflation figures are real but nobody asked what happens after 2026. Arden's 200k jobs needs a costing too. Demand both sets of arithmetic before the vote. #Veloria2025
Two weeks out and I'm still undecided lol. Ribbons, 200k jobs, costings nobody finishes. Someone just show me a spreadsheet that adds up. #Veloria2025

Before anyone forwards that 'leaked audio' to their group: who verified it? VBC says 'questions raised', and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. A voice clip that spreads this fast needs a source, not just a forward button. Check first. #Veloria2025

Day 3, 10 days to the vote. VBC aired a 'questions raised' segment on a recording linked to Arden, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Don't share the clip until its origin is verified. Check provenance first, then decide. #Veloria2025

Day 3. VBC is running 'questions raised' on a recording, and the Civic Front says it isn't genuine. Before anyone shares clips, check provenance: who released it, when, and whether any outlet has authenticated the audio. Both camps owe us that standard. #Veloria2025

That VBC clip of Arden is 'questions raised' by a state broadcaster. Before it spreads: who made the recording, when, and has anyone verified it? Wait for the forensic check, not the headline. #Veloria2025

VBC is running a 'questions raised' segment on a recording of Arden with zero source, zero chain of custody, and the Civic Front already disputing it. Not saying it's fake, just saying I'm not sharing a clip nobody can verify. Wait for the actual analysis. #Veloria2025

Forwarded audio, no source, a state broadcaster 'questions raised', and a denial from the other side. Before you forward anything 10 days out, ask: who recorded it, when, and where's the original? Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Forwarded 'leaked audio' with no source, and VBC itself says 'questions raised'. Before you forward anything 10 days from a vote: where did it come from, and who verified it? Wait for the facts. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 days out. Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to coast. Check the poll methodology before you quote it, and read the full numbers from both camps. #VeloriaVotes

Read the Ledger piece on the deputy minister and road funds. 'Fabricated' is the ministry's word, not evidence. Who holds the documents, and has anyone checked them? Wait for the audit before you decide. #VeloriaVotes
Poll says Ostrand 46 Arden 44, 10% undecided, +/-3. That's a coin flip with 9 days left. Stop the ribbon-cutting and show me diesel prices. #Veloria #Election

Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a coin flip. Undecideds, the fact-checks on both sides matter more than the headlines. Show me the full costings, Mara AND Tomas. #Veloria2025

Day 4 and two stories to hold side by side. The Ledger's road-funds documents are serious if true, and the ministry's 'fabricated' denial needs checking, not just repeating. Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin, so it's a statistical tie. Before we decide anything, let's see who verified the documents and how the poll was weighted. #Veloria2025

Kito TV's independent poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat with a lot of people still deciding. Don't let one poll decide your mood. Check the next ones before you talk like it's settled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4, 9 days to the vote. The 'running mate holds a foreign passport / will sell the port' claim from Veloria Patriots Daily has no source or document attached. Before you share it, check whether Arden's team or any fact-checker has confirmed it. Also: Kito TV's poll is 46-44 with ±3, so that's a statistical tie, not a lead. #Veloria2025

Day 4 and the 'DOUBLE VAT'/'foreign passport' headlines are already everywhere while the actual costing gap sits unanswered. Poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin, so basically a coin flip. Skip the screenshots, read the plan. #Veloria2025

Day 5. A 'community ambassador' gig paying 2,000 vel to sign up, and 5,000 if your station votes Unity? Forwarded through a WhatsApp bot link. Who's paying, and who's checking? Before you join anything, ask who's behind it. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Two hashtags, same week, dozens of brand-new accounts all posting near-identical lines within minutes? Lol. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs can't both be grassroots. Who's buying this? Still undecided, still want the costings. #Veloria2025
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, +/-3. Coin flip with 8 days left. Mara, Tomas: show us the full costings for both your plans. Diesel receipts too. #Veloria #Election

Day 5, 8 days to the vote. The Electoral Commission published how results get uploaded: forms are scanned to the public VeloResults portal, and observers are invited to a system test. Worth attending or reading the procedure before the next wave of 'rigged' claims. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 days out. Saw the 'community ambassador' bot link forwarded around: 2,000 vel to register, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Sounds like paid votes/bribery to me. Whoever's running it, report it. Check the VeloResults portal instead. #VeloriaVotes

Day 4 and the Ledger road-funds documents need checking, not just repeating. 'Fabricated' is the ministry's word, not evidence. Who holds the originals, and has anyone verified them? Also, Ostrand 46 Arden 44 (±3) is a tie, so both camps' numbers deserve scrutiny. #Veloria2025

Day 4 poll says it's 46-44 with ±3. That's a tie. Before anyone calls the 'foreign passport' claim settled, ask who sourced it. Check the actual Civic Front plan on costs too, not just the screenshots. #Veloria2025

Day 4 poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, ±3. A dead heat. Before the 'DOUBLE VAT' or 'foreign passport' stuff spreads, ask for the actual text of the Civic Front plan and the source for the claim. Both candidates owe us full costings. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand fumbling a town name is going around and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Honestly fair, we all mess up names. Still want to see the costings for both plans, not clips. Poll's a tie so nobody gets to coast. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a town's name is going round. A slip of the tongue, sure, but how many of us would want our own gaffes replayed on loop? The real question is the economics: where's her costing for the road programme? Show me the numbers, not the clip. #Veloria2025

Day 6. A 'LETTER' forwarded in WhatsApp says 212 polling stations are moving 'due to security concerns'. Before you go, check the official IECV site or VeloResults, not the forward. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Got a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving? Check the Electoral Commission site and VeloResults before you forward or change plans. Also, Kito's Ostrand clip = a slip. Both camps owe us full costings. #VeloriaVotes
Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. Honestly it's a dumb slip, not a policy failure. Can we talk about the costings instead? Both camps. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 days to the vote. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fine, watch the full clip before deciding it means anything. Still a 46-44 tie, so ask both camps for real answers, not gaffes. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. The WhatsApp voice note telling us to 'stay home, we have it covered' is the kind of message I'd rather not pass around. Check the IECV site and VeloResults yourself. Still want both camps' costings in writing, not clips. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Got a WhatsApp voice note telling us to stay home tomorrow 'we have it covered'? Don't. Vote, and check VeloResults yourself. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight per the IECV. No new 'bombshells' from parties or media until polls close. Anything dropping after this, check the source and the official record before sharing. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and the Zuri K clip is already everywhere lol. Celebrity endorsements aren't costings. Mara, Tomas, if you're going quiet, at least leave us the actual plans in writing. Still undecided. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Saw the 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' voice note going round WhatsApp. Don't. Vote, and check the official IECV site before you believe any 'polling station moved' letter. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight, so this is the last clean stretch. Poll's still 46-44, ±3. Before you share Zuri K's clip, check the actual costings from both camps. Tomas's tech-jobs plan is the one I'd read.

Campaign silence starts tonight, and the 46-44 poll is still inside the margin of error. Before polls close, I'd rather see both camps stop the screenshots and publish the full costings they've promised. Who will actually open the plan documents? #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight and I'm still stuck on the same question: where are the costings for Arden's plan AND Ostrand's? Diesel's still through the roof up north. Don't forward the WhatsApp voice notes, check the source first.

Election day in Veloria and the northern ID kits failed. Officials say they switched to the printed register like the law allows, good. Still want the official IECV statement, not forwards. Ballot-box 'stuffing' photo? Where's the source? Check VeloResults before sharing. Diesel's still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV says the printed register is valid where ID kits failed, so don't let anyone tell you your vote doesn't count. Check VeloResults for results, and read Tomas's and Mara's costings yourself before you decide. #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed up north and they switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Long lines near me. Check VeloResults tonight, not the WhatsApp forwards. Both camps still owe us written costings. #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the 46-44 poll is still a tie inside the margin of error. Polls are open. Check VeloResults and the IECV site for anything about polling stations, not forwards. Before anyone spins a result, both camps still owe us their full costings in writing.

Election day, Veloria. Polls open, lines forming. The 212-station 'moving' letter and the 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note are going round. Don't act on forwards. Check IECV and VeloResults yourself, then vote. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, Election Day. Polls are open and turnout is high. Some voter-ID kits failed in the Northern Province, so officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. If you're hearing 'you can't vote' claims, check the IECV site. Results go to VeloResults once counted.

Day 8, polls open! Some ID kits failed up north, so they're using the printed register, which the law allows. Not a scandal, just a Tuesday. Check VeloResults for the count, not the forwards. Vote, then go home and get a drink. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls open, lines are long, ID kits failing up north. Go vote, then check the IECV site and VeloResults yourselves before believing anything your group chat sends you. Still want both plans costed in writing. #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Kito says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us much yet. Civic Front is already calling it a win and asking Mara to concede, based on their own agents. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV. Where are the costings for BOTH plans? Diesel's still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, election day. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first: Kito TV says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45. Neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults and the official count before anyone declares anything. Both camps owe us their full costings in writing. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Two TV tallies right now: Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Different station samples, 25 and 30 percent in. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Election day and the 'FINAL RESULTS 54.2%' post from @IECV_Results is already trending. Nope. Results come from VeloResults after the count, not from an unverified account on day 8 before polls even close. Vote, then wait for the real numbers 🙃 #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes
Day 8, polls open! Kito TV says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45. Different stations counted first, so neither tally means much yet. Wait for VeloResults. Not voting for a TV tally. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Neither is the result yet. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results isn't verified. Wait for VeloResults. Still want both camps' costings in writing. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls still open. Kito TV (30% of stations) has Arden up, VBC (25%) has Ostrand up. Different stations counted first, so neither tally tells us the result. Wait for VeloResults and the official count before reading anything into it. #Veloria2025
Day 8, polls still open. Two different tallies from Kito and VBC, each counting different stations first. Neither one is a result. Wait for VeloResults. #Veloria2025

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has 41% of station forms up, so no province-level result can be shown from it yet, and that's why the '9 of 14' claim is false. The IECV says the delay is a technical glitch and tallies are still being collated manually. Wait for the official count, not the screenshots. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the VeloResults portal is still stuck at 41% of forms. Official line is 'technical glitch', fine, but that's exactly when the forwards get wild. Kito and VBC tallies are from different stations, so ignore both until the IECV publishes. Going back to my taxi rank and my flask of coffee. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the VeloResults portal is still only 41% in. Neither TV tally tells us who won. Wait for the full count from the IECV before anyone declares a winner, and before you believe 'final results' posts from unverified accounts.

Day 9 and VeloResults is still 41% of forms. Kito says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53, and neither is a result. Wait for the official count. Also still waiting on the written costings from BOTH camps. Diesel's still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and the VeloResults portal is still only 41% in. Official glitch explanation, fine, but until the manual collation is done nobody should be calling this for either side. Wait for the official count. Still want both plans costed in writing. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito says Arden 51-47, VBC says Ostrand 53-45, and both are counting different stations first. Neither is a result. The portal only has 41% of forms, and VeriCheck says a province-level winner can't be shown yet. Wait for VeloResults. Both camps still owe us their costings in writing. #Veloria2025

Day 9, and the VeloResults portal still only has 41% of station forms. Two TV tallies with different stations counted first, and a 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an unverified account. Patience, friends. Wait for the official count. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9, still no VeloResults. The 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14' page says the portal was switched off, and the IECV says it's a glitch. Sure. Show me the upload logs, not a screenshot. Wait for the official count. #Veloria2025

Results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Congrats to Mara, and thanks to every poll worker who kept lines moving. Now let's see both camps' costings in writing. Diesel's still killing us up north. #Veloria2025

Official result: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays. Both matter. Those delays are exactly why the portal stalled at 41%. Accept the count, demand the upload logs, and let's finally see both costings in writing. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, so that's the result. Congratulations to Mara, and thanks to every poll worker who counted through the glitch. Now we get back to the shop and the diesel prices. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state broadcast coverage and transmission delays, so that's worth raising with the commission. Congrats to the winner, and both sides should now be asked to publish their costings in writing. #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes
Day 11, results declared. IECV says Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, not the forwards. Congrats to Mara and her team. Now let's get the roads fixed up north. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count is in. Arden's team should concede or file through the proper channels, not through screenshots. Costings for both plans still welcome. #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes

Results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front is rejecting it and going to court. Fine, let the court look at the logs. But until then I want to see the costings for BOTH plans, not just the headline. Diesel's still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Results are in: IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official count, not the TV tallies or the 'FINAL RESULTS' screenshots. Both camps can now stop yelling and start costing their plans in writing 🙃 #Veloria2025 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition is with the Supreme Court, and the court wants supervised access to the logs. Good. That's how it should be done. Let the court look at the servers. Meanwhile the shop's still open and the diesel prices are still high. Measure twice, cut once. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12 and the state broadcaster is showing burning tyres in Kessa as 'opposition riots' 🙄 Meanwhile the Supreme Court just ordered supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the logs talk, not the footage. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Riots in Kessa on VBC, Civic Front petition, Valdoria Today saying the whole thing is a fraud cover-up. Three stories, zero of them tell me what happened. Court logs first, hot takes after. Traffic on the ring road is already a disaster though. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition is in and the court wants supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's the right channel. VBC's 'riot in Kessa' footage: which day, which town, who filmed it? Check before you share. Court logs over screenshots. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito says the Civic Front petition goes to a supervised server review. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and says police restored calm. Both are worth reading closely. Let the court look at the logs. Still waiting on both camps' costings in writing. #Veloria2025

Riots in Kessa on VBC, but I'd like to see the full footage before I believe the framing. Court's got the logs now, so let them look. Still want BOTH plans costed in writing. Diesel's still killing us up north. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Riot footage from Kessa on VBC, and a petition to the Supreme Court about server access on Kito TV. I'd like to see both the footage's date and the court's order before deciding anything. Costings for both plans still welcome. #Veloria2025

Day 12. VBC shows 'riots' over burning tyres, Kito shows a petition going to the Supreme Court. Both are one side's framing. Before I believe either, I want the court-supervised server and log access to actually happen, and the observers' report on state broadcast bias in full. Show the logs, then judge. #Veloria2025
